children: Here’s a challenge. Using the five clues below, identify the company that is being talked about here.
1 I have become the largest player nationally in less than two decades and am considered to be a pioneer in this industry.
2 I got listed through a corporate restructuring of my parent, which was split twice last decade due to a family settlement.
3 My MD is a resident of a foreign country and never let his personal challenges with the Delhi Police several years ago intrude into his professional responsibilities.
4 My negative earnings last year, for the first time since listing, pulled my stock down by almost half, and it now needs to more than quadruple from current levels to reach its all-time high.
5 Despite negative returns to shareholders in recent years, institutional stake has been steadily on the rise and is now about 30 per cent.

title: Who Am I? October 11, 2026
